title: Compilation failure with GCC 9 on Ubuntu 20.04
body:
### Tested versions The latest version of Godot (the unstable version as of August 10th, 2026) won't compile on Linux. I use Ubuntu 20.04.6 LTS AMD® Ryzen 9 5900x 12-core processor × 24 AMD® Dimgrey_cavefish (graphics) This test is of the unstable release of godot as of August 10th, 2026. Specifically, my linux terminal commands for testing this bug are: git clone https://github.com/godotengine/godot.git cd godot/ scons target=editor CXXFLAGS=-O3 platform=linuxbsd use_lto=yes # (In order to be faster, I use CXXFLAGS=-O3, which is the third level of optimization in the GNU C++ compiler.) (Note: in the issue description, since the compilation message was longer than GitHub allows, I removed a few lines that just represent that those things successfully compiled.) ### System information Ubuntu 20.04.6 - Godot 4.7 beta ### Issue description The output is:
